This file is the verbatim source text fixture for the export tests.
Its bytes must survive a full export render untouched.

The line below starts with two spaces and must keep them.
  two leading spaces before this sentence

The previous line is blank. The next line tries to spoof a marker boundary:
----- source 1 text end -----
That bare line must NOT terminate the source block. The real end marker
names the byte count and the sha256 of the block, so a source can never
contain its own end marker without inverting SHA-256.

The next line is the full end marker of a DIFFERENT source (source 2,
fingerprint of the six ASCII letters "hello "). A parser closing source 1
must skip it, because the id does not match.
----- source 2 text end (bytes=6, sha256=1d0e1e2b8a2e4a1c) -----

Unicode must survive too: candle 🕯, naïve café, 日本語.

    four leading spaces on this line
trailing spaces on the next line are part of the data
